title: Lake Tahoe Sunset Wine Tasting Cruise
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Sail into the sunset on the Tahoe Paradise, a double-decker yacht that offers a unique cruise experience on Lake Tahoe. As you glide across the crystal-clear waters, admire breathtaking mountain views while sipping on a curated selection of local wines paired with delicious small bites. This journey highlights Lake Tahoe’s connection to California’s wine country, featuring wine selections from Joyce Wine Co. Enjoy a variety of wines including, Albariño, Sauvignon Blanc, and Pinot Noir, complemented by gourmet appetizers like artisan cheeses and smoked salmon crostini.

- Unforgettable sunset cruise on Lake Tahoe aboard the Tahoe Paradise
- Enjoy a selection of local wines paired with gourmet small bites
- Experience stunning views of the Sierra Nevada mountains
- Ideal for wine lovers and those seeking a relaxing evening on the water
